overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. A medical university in Dnipro, east-central Ukraine, with an International Faculty and a preparatory department for foreign citizens. No official page found so far names the degree programmes open to foreign applicants or their language of instruction, so only the preparatory course is listed as a programme and the degree programmes are held back; Dnipro is a front-line region, so operating conditions are checked first. Draft record built from search-snippet leads on 2026-10-11; every field below is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

accreditation.note: Record accreditation only with the official certificate or the NAQA register as the source. (Lead from a re-check search on 2026-10-11, summary only: the Ministry "Study in Ukraine" programmes page, https://studyinukraine.gov.ua/study-in-ukraine/programmes-and-courses/?areas=22, is said to describe the university as an institution of the 4th accreditation level — an older national classification; not recorded.)

recognition.note: Recognition is decided separately by each destination country's regulator (for example India's National Medical Commission). Record it only from a tier-4 page on a recognition-authority host the owner has listed (N24 b; none listed yet), quoting what that page says, with its date. A World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS) listing is a directory entry, not recognition; institutional registration (EDEBO) and programme accreditation (NAQA) are separate claims. Never imply a right to practise in any country. Agency sites (THIRD-PARTY, e.g. mbbsadmissionabroad.in; re-check search 2026-10-11) claim WHO and NMC approval — promotional, not evidence, never recorded.

accommodation.note: Record only published hostel details (availability, price, year). Snippet (official payment terms, undated): first-year foreign students pay tuition and hostel fees for the whole year in full, and from the second year by semester.
